email_subject: Application - Social Media Coordinator and Strategist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Coordinator and Strategist position. With my background in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I bring a unique blend of hands-on publishing experience and strategic insight.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my ability to create engaging copy and coordinate content across platforms. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and social media integration, demonstrating my capability to manage multi-platform content and analyze performance.

I am highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. I am eager to contribute to your team's fast-paced digital media operations and grow my expertise in social media strategy.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
